title.narrative: Promoting the rights to Housing Land and properties through Mitigation of Gender Base Violence among women girls in Gujba, Geidam LGAs, Yobe State

description.narrative: ltpgta. This project will address Thematic Envelope 1: Underfunded Sector Area-Based Protection Response (US$ 6 million)lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtb. How this project will contribute to the protection of girls and vulnerable women.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThrough this project, the Protection of women and girls will be key in the actualization of the project goal toward various implementation strategies that address cultural barriers and community perceptions that hinder women and girls' participation, the steps taken Women and Girls: face multiple forms of oppression, which further reduce their power and choice. They are at increased risk of violence and face increased barriers to accessing support. Following the crisis in the northeast and also the farmer's headers crisis in Yobe state, Conflict resolution, and peacebuilding strategies have thrown into stark relief just how critical it is, especially for Girls and Vulnerable women which will aid their resilience building back to “normal,”ltbrgtThis project will support vulnerable Women and girls in the targeted project locations it will also promote women and girls’ safety in the communities and freedom from discrimination, harassment, and violence to safely generate an income. Women’s economic empowerment in contexts affected by crisis and displacement must address these intersecting barriers to economic opportunities which the strategies this project hopes to achieve.lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgtc. What specific innovation the project is bringing?lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtConflict resolution strategies through community-based management for dispute resolution and active engagement of Relevant government agencies to support the processes will be used where issues of farmers-herders are of concern resulting in dispute and cultural norms that create barriers to women's access to HLP Rights and GBV issues especially IPV due to the HLP issues and increasing vulnerability of women and girls in the targeted project location, Community, Religiose and Government stakeholders will lead the processes through the dissemination of policies that promote access to Housing Land and Properties. The conflict mediation strategies to foster peace-building will be among the early initiatives in the northeast especially Yobe State on conflict resolution and peacebuilding.lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgtSahei Gender Development Initiative (SGDI) and Novel Alliance for Development Aid (NADA) intend to reach a total of 2,221 individuals (40%women, 30%Girls, 20%men and 10%Boys) including those living with disabilities in camps, and host communities. The project will support advocacy visits to key stakeholders (40% women, 60% men) to community and government stakeholders on promoting HLP rights for women and girls and GBV risk mitigation and response. Also, the capacity of staff, Community groups, and relevant Government agencies (Ministry of Environment and Urban Planning, SEMA, NEMA, YOGIS, Ministry of Women Affairs, FIDA, and other relevant institutions will be built to support effective project implementation. 20,000 (40%women, 30% girls, 20% men, and 10% boys) will be reached with awareness and sensitization on cultural barriers affecting HLP rights against women and girls and GBV risk mitigation.lt/pgtltpgt ltbrgtMoreover, through the community leaders, the SGDI and NADA will establish/strengthen community-based dialogue and mediation committees to support mediation and dialogue that will foster conflict resolution for sustainable peace and development. Monthly Radio program including the daily airing of jingles in key advocacy messages on HLP rights and GBV/PSEA risk mitigation, key stakeholders will serve as guests during radio talk shows to reach out to the larger population in almost all the LGAs in Yobe State. Women and girls will be empowered with livelihood skills, 200 women and girls including 70 survivors of SGBV, and other GBV-related issues identified and documented through the case management processes with a socio-economic start-up kit for resilience building and reintegration. ltbrgtlt/pgt
